reader.requirement: At --std 85 a paragraph or section of a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR declarative section may be referenced from a different declarative section or from the nondeclarative portion only by PERFORM; GO TO, GO TO DEPENDING, ALTER and SORT/MERGE INPUT/OUTPUT PROCEDURE references from there are refused; references within the same section are free.
